observed_behaviors.title: Controller requests safe state when sensor sample is stale
observed_behaviors.body: The timeout monitor compares elapsed time since the last valid sensor sample against a configured threshold and requests a safe-state transition when the threshold is exceeded.

observed_behaviors.title: Diagnostic event is emitted when timeout transition occurs

requirement_candidates.title: Controller shall request safe state on sensor timeout
requirement_candidates.body: If the primary speed sensor has no valid sample for the configured timeout, the controller shall request a safe-state transition.
requirement_candidates.review_question: Confirm whether the configured timeout is product-profile specific or fixed by the safety concept.

requirement_candidates.title: Controller shall emit a diagnostic event on timeout transition
requirement_candidates.body: When sensor timeout handling requests safe state, the controller shall emit a diagnostic event for service and traceability.
requirement_candidates.review_question: Confirm whether diagnostic event emission is required behavior or an implementation detail.
